lines.zh: 军士沿着巢口来回走，步子很重
lines.en: The soldier paces the nest mouth with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 它走在队伍外侧，把工蚁挡在里面
lines.en: It walks the column's outside, workers kept within.

lines.zh: 上颚太大，走起来有点晃
lines.en: Its mandibles are so large it walks a little unsteady.

lines.zh: 它每走几步就抬头嗅一次
lines.en: Every few steps it lifts its head to scent.

lines.zh: 它绕到队尾，又折回队首
lines.en: It drops to the column's rear, then returns to the front.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住三只工蚁
lines.en: Its shadow covers three workers at once.

lines.zh: 它顺着墙根走，专挑转角停
lines.en: It walks the wall's base, pausing at every corner.

lines.zh: 六足落地有声，像敲小鼓
lines.en: Its six feet strike the ground like a small drum.

lines.zh: 它把队伍带过一段窄道
lines.en: It leads the column through a narrow stretch.

lines.zh: 它走在最后，边退边看
lines.en: It walks last, checking behind as it goes.

lines.zh: 它的甲上有旧伤留下的凹痕
lines.en: Old dents mark its shell.

lines.zh: 它走过卵室门口，脚步放轻
lines.en: Passing the nursery door, it softens its step.

lines.zh: 它把挡路的碎石推到一边
lines.en: It shoves the rubble out of the way.

lines.zh: 它的触角始终一高一低
lines.en: Its antennae stay at different heights, one high, one low.

lines.zh: 我抬着上颚，沿巢壁巡一圈。
lines.en: I carry my mandibles high and patrol the nest wall.

lines.zh: 我的触角扫过地面，找味道。
lines.en: My antennae sweep the ground, hunting a scent.

lines.zh: 它守在洞口，谁也不许过
lines.en: It holds the mouth; nobody passes.

lines.zh: 它把上颚互相磨了磨
lines.en: It grinds its mandibles against each other.

lines.zh: 它站在队伍外侧，像一堵矮墙
lines.en: It stands on the column's flank like a low wall.

lines.zh: 有工蚁经过，它用触角点一下
lines.en: A worker passes; it taps it with an antenna.

lines.zh: 它在数出去和回来的人数
lines.en: It counts who goes out and who comes back.

lines.zh: 它把身体横过来，堵住半个洞口
lines.en: It turns broadside, filling half the entrance.

lines.zh: 闲下来时，它舔自己的前足
lines.en: In quiet moments it licks its forefeet.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸很沉，腹节一鼓一收
lines.en: Its breathing is heavy; the abdomen swells and falls.

lines.zh: 它听着巢外的风，一动不动
lines.en: It listens to the wind outside, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 它把一块松动的石头踩实
lines.en: It stamps a loose stone firm.

lines.zh: 它抬头看洞顶，像在算高度
lines.en: It looks at the ceiling as if measuring it.

lines.zh: 它守着这条道，已经守了两天
lines.en: It has held this path for two days.

lines.zh: 它的上颚张了一下，又合上
lines.en: Its mandibles open once, then close.

lines.zh: 它直视你，没有一点退让
lines.en: It looks straight at you without yielding an inch.

lines.zh: 军士把你当成要清走的东西
lines.en: The soldier counts you as something to clear away.

lines.zh: 它低头看你的腿，那里最好咬
lines.en: It eyes your legs, the easiest place to bite.

lines.zh: 它向前半步，把洞口挡得更严
lines.en: It steps forward, sealing the entrance tighter.

lines.zh: 它的触角对着你，尖端在抖
lines.en: Its antennae aim at you, tips quivering.

lines.zh: 它没叫，只是把身体压低
lines.en: It makes no sound, only lowers its body.

lines.zh: 它已经把你归进巢外那一类
lines.en: It has already filed you among things outside the nest.

lines.zh: 它侧过头，让你看清它的颚
lines.en: It turns its head so you can see its jaws.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，等你先动
lines.en: It stares at you, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 它身上的甲裂了一道缝
lines.en: A seam splits open in its shell.

lines.zh: 它闷叫一声，牙还咬着
lines.en: It grunts once, jaws still clamped.

lines.zh: 受伤让它更凶，不是更怕
lines.en: Being hurt makes it fiercer, not frightened.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，又顶回来
lines.en: It gives a step, then pushes back in.

lines.zh: 它把伤口那侧转向墙
lines.en: It turns its wounded side to the wall.

lines.zh: 血从节间渗出来
lines.en: Fluid seeps between its segments.

lines.zh: 它的颚上沾了自己的体液
lines.en: Its own hemolymph stains its jaws.

lines.zh: 这一击没让它松口
lines.en: The blow does not make it let go.

lines.zh: 它用前足抹了抹腹部
lines.en: It wipes its abdomen with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 它站直了，把伤藏在身下
lines.en: It straightens up, hiding the wound beneath itself.

lines.zh: 它不吃递来的东西，只守门
lines.en: It will not eat what is offered; it guards.

lines.zh: 你晃诱饵，它把颚张得更开
lines.en: You wave the bait; its jaws open wider.

lines.zh: 食物进了巢才算食物
lines.en: Food only counts once it is inside the nest.

lines.zh: 它把诱饵拨到门外
lines.en: It flicks the bait outside the door.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻，退开半步
lines.en: It sniffs the offering and backs off half a step.

lines.zh: 它饿，但更怕有人趁它低头
lines.en: It is hungry, but more afraid of who might come while it bows.

lines.zh: 它用颚夹起果子，往巢里送
lines.en: It grips the fruit and carries it inward.

lines.zh: 你手上的味道太杂，它不收
lines.en: The scent on your hands is muddled; it refuses.

lines.zh: 它只吃工蚁分给它的那一份
lines.en: It eats only the share a worker gives it.

lines.zh: 它把食物留在门口，继续守着
lines.en: It leaves the food at the door and keeps watch.

lines.zh: 它一撞，你被顶得后退
lines.en: It slams into you and drives you back.

lines.zh: 它的肩甲硬得像块石头
lines.en: Its shoulder plate is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 它用身体把你挤出洞口
lines.en: It uses its body to push you from the entrance.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，它连晃都没晃
lines.en: You hit it, and it does not even sway.

lines.zh: 它的颚擦过你的膝盖
lines.en: Its mandibles graze your knee.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，它站得更稳了
lines.en: After the collision it plants itself more firmly.

lines.zh: 它把重心压低，肩往前送
lines.en: It lowers its weight and drives a shoulder forward.

lines.zh: 你被挤到墙边，退路窄了
lines.en: You are squeezed to the wall; the way back narrows.

lines.zh: 它撞开你，回头又补了一下
lines.en: It shoulders you aside, then comes back for another.

lines.zh: 它撞在你盾上，盾面响了一声
lines.en: It strikes your shield, and the shield rings once.

lines.zh: 繁殖是皇族的事，它只管打
lines.en: Breeding belongs to the royals; it only fights.

lines.zh: 婚飞时，它把守三个出口
lines.en: During the mating flights it guards three exits.

lines.zh: 它替出巢的皇族清出一条路
lines.en: It clears a road for the royals leaving the nest.

lines.zh: 有外来的雄蚁，它先咬再说
lines.en: An outside male appears; it bites first and asks nothing.

lines.zh: 它守着产房，连工蚁都要盘问
lines.en: It guards the nursery and questions even workers.

lines.zh: 它的身体生来就不是为产卵
lines.en: Its body was never made for laying eggs.

lines.zh: 交配季的味道让它烦躁
lines.en: The mating season's scent makes it restless.

lines.zh: 它把求偶的雄蚁赶出洞口
lines.en: It drives courting males out of the tunnel.

lines.zh: 女皇的孩子，它一只只护着
lines.en: It guards the queen's young one by one.

lines.zh: 它不懂交配，只懂挡在前面
lines.en: It does not understand mating, only standing in front.

lines.zh: 它叼起一块石头，堵住缺口
lines.en: It picks up a stone and plugs a gap.

lines.zh: 它把掉落的东西踢回巢里
lines.en: It kicks dropped things back into the nest.

lines.zh: 它只捡能堵门的东西
lines.en: It picks up only what can block a door.

lines.zh: 它用颚夹着骨头，拖了很远
lines.en: It drags a bone a long way in its jaws.

lines.zh: 它捡起幼虫，送回育婴室
lines.en: It picks up a larva and returns it to the nursery.

lines.zh: 太重了，它叫来两只工蚁
lines.en: Too heavy, so it calls two workers over.

lines.zh: 它把碎壳堆在洞口外
lines.en: It piles broken shells outside the entrance.

lines.zh: 它的颚只能夹，不能捧
lines.en: Its jaws can grip but cannot cradle.

lines.zh: 你丢的箭，它折成两段
lines.en: It snaps your dropped arrow in two.

lines.zh: 它把异物一路送到巢外
lines.en: It carries the foreign object all the way out.

lines.zh: 它抬起头，颚已经张开
lines.en: It raises its head, jaws already open.

lines.zh: 你靠近巢口三步，它就动了
lines.en: Three steps from the entrance, and it moves.

lines.zh: 它的触角压低，向前倾
lines.en: Its antennae lower, tilting forward.

lines.zh: 它判定你属于巢外的一切
lines.en: The soldier rules you part of everything outside.

lines.zh: 它没有警告，直接冲过来
lines.en: It gives no warning and charges straight in.

lines.zh: 它把身体横在门口
lines.en: It throws its body across the doorway.

lines.zh: 它发出一声很低的摩擦声
lines.en: It rasps out a very low sound.

lines.zh: 工蚁往后退，把场地让出来
lines.en: Workers fall back, clearing the ground.

lines.zh: 它的后足在土里刨了两下
lines.en: Its hind feet scrape the soil twice.

lines.zh: 它认准你的喉咙高度
lines.en: It fixes on the height of your throat.

lines.zh: 它开始跑了，六足一起动
lines.en: It breaks into a run, all six legs at once.

lines.zh: 它要让巢外的东西记住这道门
lines.en: It means to teach the outside what this door costs.

lines.zh: 它低着头冲，颚在前
lines.en: It charges head-down, jaws first.

lines.zh: 它每一步都把土踩出坑
lines.en: Each step punches a pit in the soil.

lines.zh: 它不绕，直直地奔你来
lines.en: It does not veer; it comes straight at you.

lines.zh: 它的尾针竖着，随时会扎
lines.en: Its stinger stands upright, ready to stab.

lines.zh: 你退，它就跟，始终在三步内
lines.en: You retreat; it follows, always within three steps.

lines.zh: 它撞翻一只挡路的工蚁
lines.en: It knocks a worker out of its path.

lines.zh: 它的颚一直张着，没合过
lines.en: Its jaws have stayed open the whole way.

lines.zh: 它在找你的脚踝和膝盖
lines.en: It is looking for your ankles and knees.

lines.zh: 它把洞口交给了另一只军士
lines.en: It hands the entrance to another soldier.

lines.zh: 它越跑越快，声音越来越响
lines.en: It runs faster, louder with every stride.

lines.zh: 它撞到你面前才收步
lines.en: It brakes only when it is right on you.

lines.zh: 你身后是墙，它知道
lines.en: The wall is behind you, and it knows.

lines.zh: 它一口咬住你的小腿
lines.en: It bites down on your calf.

lines.zh: 上颚合拢，护甲被咬出印
lines.en: Its jaws close, leaving a print in your armor.

lines.zh: 尾针从下面扎上来
lines.en: The stinger drives up from below.

lines.zh: 它咬住就不松，往后拽
lines.en: It locks its jaws and pulls backward.

lines.zh: 它用头顶你的腹，把你顶退
lines.en: It rams your middle with its head.

lines.zh: 一口下去，皮甲裂了
lines.en: One bite, and the leather splits.

lines.zh: 它咬你的手，逼你放开武器
lines.en: It bites your hand to make you drop the weapon.

lines.zh: 它左右甩头，把你往地上带
lines.en: It whips its head side to side, dragging you down.

lines.zh: 尾针扎进大腿，麻了一圈
lines.en: The stinger enters your thigh; numbness spreads.

lines.zh: 它撞你一下，紧接着就咬
lines.en: It butts you once, then bites immediately.

lines.zh: 新孵的军士第一件事是磨颚
lines.en: The new soldier's first act is to hone its jaws.

lines.zh: 它比工蚁大一圈，颚也宽
lines.en: It is a size larger than a worker, with wider jaws.

lines.zh: 它从育婴室爬出，直接走向洞口
lines.en: It climbs from the nursery and heads straight for the entrance.

lines.zh: 还没站稳，它就开始巡逻
lines.en: Before it finds its balance, it starts patrolling.

lines.zh: 它的甲还是浅色，很快会变深
lines.en: Its shell is still pale; it will darken soon.

lines.zh: 工蚁绕开它走，给它让路
lines.en: Workers give it a wide berth.

lines.zh: 它接到的第一个任务是守门
lines.en: Its first assignment is the door.

lines.zh: 它试着咬了一口石壁
lines.en: It tests its jaws on the stone wall.

lines.zh: 巢口的队伍里多了一个宽肩
lines.en: The column at the mouth gains a broader pair of shoulders.

lines.zh: 它出生那天，蚁穴的防线厚了一寸
lines.en: The day it was born, the nest's defense thickened by an inch.

lines.zh: 火燎到背甲，它滚进湿泥
lines.en: Fire catches its back plate; it rolls into wet mud.

lines.zh: 它砸下来，六足先着地
lines.en: It drops and lands on all six feet.

lines.zh: 水灌进气管，它拼命划动
lines.en: Water floods its airways; it thrashes hard.

lines.zh: 爆风把它掀翻，腹面朝天
lines.en: The blast flips it, belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 箭杆插在甲缝里，晃了晃
lines.en: The arrow shaft sticks in a seam and wobbles.

lines.zh: 法术灼过它的触角，焦了半截
lines.en: Magic scorches one antenna, burning half of it.

lines.zh: 饿了几天，它连颚都懒得张
lines.en: After days without food, it will not even open its jaws.

lines.zh: 雷击穿过身体，六足一软
lines.en: Lightning runs through it, and its six legs buckle.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，它抓着空处
lines.en: No soil in the void; it clutches at nothing.
